info.name: GaTe Parking API
info.description: Run the requests top to bottom (Collection Runner or `npx newman run`). 'Login' stores the token and every other request uses it. Needs the sample data: `npm run seed -w backend`. Defaults sign in as the seeded user Anna, a second user Petr (to check users cannot reach each other's vehicles) and the seeded admin Eva (password gate-parking-dev).

item.name: Week 6: auth, vehicles, employee access
item.description: Health, login, vehicle CRUD and admin employee management. Login and Admin login store the tokens the Week 7 folder needs.

request.description: Signs in and saves the JWT token into the collection variable 'token'.
Creates a vehicle. A random plate is generated each time so it never clashes (409).
PUT replaces the whole vehicle, so the body sends every field (PATCH sends only the changed ones).
PUT needs all five fields. Sending only one is refused; use PATCH for that.
Signs in as a second seeded user and saves the token into 'otherToken'. The next requests use it to reach Anna's vehicle.
Petr asks for Anna's vehicle. Vehicles are private, so this is refused.

exec: pm.test('Explains why', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('You can only view your own vehicle'));

request.description: Petr tries to replace Anna's vehicle with a valid body. Refused.

exec: pm.test('Explains why', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('You can only change your own vehicle'));

request.description: Petr tries to edit Anna's vehicle. Refused.

exec: pm.test('Explains why', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('You can only change your own vehicle'));

request.description: Petr tries to delete Anna's vehicle. Refused.

exec: pm.test('Explains why', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('You can only remove your own vehicle'));

item.name: 15. Owner still sees the vehicle unchanged

request.description: Back as Anna: the refused requests above did not change or delete anything.

exec: pm.test('Not changed by the other user', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().model).to.eql('Corolla'));

item.description: US 4 reserve a spot, US 11 edit, US 3 start and end parking, plus the vehicle deletion guard. Logs in by itself, so this folder can be run alone. Needs the sample data (npm run seed -w backend).

item.name: 34. Delete a car with an upcoming reservation (expect 409)

request.description: The vehicle deletion guard: a car with an upcoming or active reservation cannot be removed.

exec: pm.test('Contains the new reservation', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(r => r.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('reservationId'))).to.be.true);
pm.test('Offers at least one spot', () => pm.expect(spots.length).to.be.above(0));

item.name: Week 8: delete reservations and notifications
item.description: US 6 delete a reservation and US 8 in-app notifications. Logs in by itself, so this folder can be run alone. Needs the sample data (npm run seed -w backend). The scheduled reminders (start_soon, end_soon, spot_unavailable) need a minute of waiting, so they are not part of this run; the deleted notification is created right away.
